title: 第402章 怎么会是你第401章 是人是鬼
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 白莲教匪如潮水般一波波涌向那座在火光中屹立的庙宇。
他们眼神狂热，面目狰狞，口中高呼“无生老母，真空家乡”，对死亡毫无畏惧，仿佛那鲜血与杀戮本身，就是一场盛大的祭祀。
教中高层早已明言，今夜血洗真君庙，以生灵魂血污秽庙宇，破其金身灵光，断其与冥冥中过去感应的联系，方能绝此后患，为圣教涤荡南疆扫清障碍。
“杀！血祭真君，恭迎真空！”
“破庙！毁像！一个不留！”
凄厉的嚎叫与兵刃撞击声、垂死的呻吟交织，将月色都晕染上了一层不祥的血色。
叶欣诚身披数创，银绶公服早已破烂染血，手中一柄横刀却依旧挥舞如风，牢牢钉在庙门石阶之前。
他身边，原本带来的三百精锐与黑风哨卡、巡检司残兵，此刻已倒下大半，只剩下不足百人，背靠背结成圆阵，死死抵住数倍于己的教匪狂攻。
人人带伤，血透重甲，却无一人后退。
叶欣诚虎口崩裂，左肩一道深可见骨的伤口不断涌出鲜血，每一次挥刀都牵扯出钻心的疼痛。
他目光扫过阵前，三个气息沉凝如山、穿着绣有金色莲纹黑袍的道台境高手，成品字形将他隐隐围在中央，并不急于强攻，只是不断施加压力，消耗他的气力，同时指挥着普通教匪冲击军阵。
更远处，在那片被重重教匪拱卫的阴影里，隐隐有一股令他心悸的、更加深沉晦涩的气息蛰伏着，如同毒蛇凝视。
叶欣诚心中冰寒。果然有法相高手压阵！
难怪教匪如此有恃无恐，不计伤亡地猛攻。对方的目的很明确，就是要用鲜血和生命填平这真君庙前的每一寸土地，完成那邪恶的血祭。
“大人！东面快顶不住了！”
“弩箭用完了！”
“叶头儿，弟兄们……撑不住了！”
身边传来部下嘶哑的呼喊，带着绝望。
叶欣诚看到，外围的军阵又薄弱了一圈，不断有熟悉的身影惨叫着倒下，被疯狂的教匪拖出去，瞬间分尸。
一股浓烈的无力感与悲愤涌上心头。
自从当年在平谷县参与调查渤海王案后，他累功升迁，后因功被调入京城，后又得太子和高鹏程赏识，外放滇州，一路虽凶险不断，却也凭着手中刀与心中正气，屡破大案，剿匪安民，官至银绶捕头，可谓一帆风顺。
他本以为，凭着自己一身修为与麾下儿郎，即便不能涤荡群魔，至少也能守住这一方百姓，不负太子与高大人所托。
可今夜……面对这蓄谋已久、高手尽出的白莲教，面对这赤裸裸的血腥屠戮，他第一次感到如此力不从心。
身边的弟兄正在一个个死去，真君庙危在旦夕，而自己……恐怕也要埋骨于此了。
“平谷……李叶青……”
叶欣诚脑海中，莫名闪过那个早已消失在传闻中、却总让他觉得事情并未了结的名字。
若他在此，大抵也无能为力吧。
嘴角带起一丝无奈的笑容，叶欣诚深吸一口气，压下翻腾的气血与剧痛，眼中重新燃起熊熊火焰。
他猛地一震手中横刀，刀身嗡鸣，将上面沾染的血污震散。
content_en:
The White Lotus cult bandits rushed towards the temple standing in the light of fire like a tide.
Their eyes were wild and their faces were ferocious. They chanted "No living mother, empty hometown". They had no fear of death, as if the blood and killing itself were a grand sacrifice.
The high-level leaders of the sect have already made it clear that they will cleanse the temple of the True Lord with blood tonight, defile the temple with the soul blood, break the aura of his golden body, and cut off his connection with the past induction in the underworld. Only then can he avoid future troubles and clear the way for the holy religion to cleanse the southern border.
"Kill! Blood Sacrifice True Lord, welcome to the vacuum!"
"Destroy the temple! Destroy the statues! Leave no one behind!"
The shrill howls intertwined with the clashing sounds of weapons and dying moans, turning the moonlight into an ominous blood color.
Ye Xincheng was covered in wounds, and his silver ribbon uniform was torn and stained with blood. However, he still waved a horizontal knife in his hand like the wind, nailing it firmly to the stone steps of the temple gate.
Beside him, most of the 300 elites and remnants of the Black Wind Checkpoint and Inspection Department that he had brought with him had fallen down at this moment, with only less than a hundred people left. They formed a back-to-back circular formation to resist the violent attack of the cult bandits several times their size.
Everyone was injured and their heavy armor was bleeding, but no one retreated.
Ye Xincheng's tiger's mouth collapsed, and a bone-deep wound on his left shoulder continued to gush out blood. Every time he swung the knife, he felt excruciating pain.
He glanced at the front of the formation, where he saw three Taoist masters with a mountain-like aura and wearing black robes embroidered with golden lotus patterns. The finished glyphs vaguely surrounded him in the center. They were not in a hurry to attack, but just kept exerting pressure and consuming his energy. At the same time, he directed the ordinary cult bandits to attack the military formation.
Farther away, in the shadow guarded by numerous cult bandits, there was a faint, deeper and more obscure aura dormant that made his heart palpitate, like the gaze of a poisonous snake.
"Dharma..."
Ye Xincheng felt cold in his heart. Sure enough, there are Dharma masters taking over the battle!
No wonder the religious bandits were so confident that they attacked fiercely regardless of casualties. The other party's purpose is very clear, which is to fill every inch of land in front of the True King's Temple with blood and life to complete the evil blood sacrifice.
"Sir! Dongfang can't bear it any longer!"
"The crossbow bolts are out!"
"Boss Ye, brothers... we can't hold on any longer!"
The hoarse shouts of his subordinates came from beside him, with a hint of despair.
Ye Xincheng saw that the outer military formation was weakening again. Familiar figures kept screaming and falling down. They were dragged out by the crazy bandits and dismembered in an instant.
A strong sense of powerlessness and grief and anger surged into my heart.
Since he participated in the investigation of the Bohai King case in Pinggu County, he has been promoted through meritorious service, and was later transferred to the capital for his meritorious service. Later, he was appreciated by the prince and Gao Pengcheng, and was sent to Dianzhou. Although there were constant dangers along the way, he relied on the knife in his hand and the righteousness in his heart to repeatedly solve major cases, suppress bandits and bring peace to the people, and he went to the silver ribbon to arrest the head. It was all smooth sailing.
He originally thought that with his own cultivation and his subordinates, even if he could not cleanse the demons, he could at least protect the people in this area and live up to the trust of the prince and Lord Gao.
But tonight... facing the White Lotus Sect, which had been planning for a long time and had all its masters, and facing this naked bloody massacre, he felt so powerless for the first time.
The brothers around him are dying one by one, the Zhenjun Temple is in danger, and I... am afraid I will be buried here.
"Pinggu...Li Yeqing..."
In Ye Xincheng's mind, the name that had long since disappeared in rumors, but always made him feel that the matter was not settled, flashed across his mind.
If he were here, he probably wouldn't be able to do anything.
With a helpless smile on his lips, Ye Xincheng took a deep breath, suppressed the boiling blood and pain, and rekindled the blazing fire in his eyes.
He suddenly shook the sword in his hand, and the blade buzzed, scattering the blood stained on it.
